    Lattice saturation of presilting cones and planar sector covers #

    Proves Lemma 2.1(1) (lem:fan-lattice) and Lemma 8.2 (lem:sector):

    • mem_gVectorCone_iff_exists_in_add: the integral lattice points of a presilting cone C(P) are precisely the g-vectors of objects in add(P).
    • exists_sector_cover_of_mediants_in_fan: if two presilting complexes E, L satisfy Hom(E, L[1]) = 0 and all Stern–Brocot mediants up to depth dim_k Hom(L, E[1]) lie in Σ(R), then the planar sector between [E] and [L] is covered by at most 2^j compatible presilting sectors.

      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_sector_cover_of_mediants_in_fan {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (E L : TwoTerm R) (hE : E.IsPresilting) (hL : L.IsPresilting) (hEL : shiftedHomFinrank k E L = 0) (hc : ∀ v ∈ sternBrocotMediants (shiftedHomFinrank k L E) E.projectiveClass L.projectiveClass, (realProjectiveClass R) v ∈ gVectorFanSupport R) :
      ∃ (s : List (TwoTerm R × TwoTerm R)), s.length ≤ 2 ^ shiftedHomFinrank k L E ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, (p.1.directSum p.2).IsPresilting) ∧ sectorBetween ((realProjectiveClass R) E.projectiveClass) ((realProjectiveClass R) L.projectiveClass) = {x : RealProjectiveSpace R | ∃ p ∈ s, x ∈ sectorBetween ((realProjectiveClass R) p.1.projectiveClass) ((realProjectiveClass R) p.2.projectiveClass)}
